## [C++ Derivatives Pricing Library](https://github.com/tsereir/Derivative-Products-Hedging)
Code: [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/tsereir/Derivative-Products-Hedging)

Monte-Carlo engine for derivatives pricing with Greeks computation, supporting multiple financial products.

- Monte-Carlo option pricing with sensitivity analysis (Greeks)
- Supports multiple financial products with parameterized inputs
- Reads product parameters from configuration files

---

## [Multi-Cash Flow Derivatives Hedging](https://github.com/tsereir/Multi-Cash-Flow-Hedging-)
Code: [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/tsereir/Multi-Cash-Flow-Hedging-)

Hedging and risk management platform for derivatives with multiple cash flows, built on a real calendar framework.

- Constructs hedging portfolios with real calendar data
- Computes optimal asset allocation across cash flow dates

---

## [American Option Pricing](https://github.com/tsereir/American-Option-Pricing/tree/master)
Code: [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/tsereir/American-Option-Pricing/tree/master)

Longstaff-Schwartz implementation for American option pricing within a multidimensional Black-Scholes framework.

- Handles basket, geometric, and performance options
- Reads market data from JSON input files
- Outputs pricing results with exercise boundary analysis

---

## [Systematic Strategies Back-Testing Engine](https://github.com/tsereir/Systematic-Strategies-)
Code: [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/tsereir/Systematic-Strategies-)

C#/.NET framework for systematic equity strategies with full transaction-cost modeling and performance attribution.

- Forward and backtesting with realistic cost assumptions
- gRPC communication layer for market data
- Strategy performance attribution and analytics

## Cross-Asset Structured Product Platform

End-to-end structured product pricing and hedging platform spanning three languages.

- **C++ pricer** for structured product valuation
- **Python** hedging engine and portfolio builder
- **JS/Node.js** GUI for trade visualization and management

---

## Kalman Filter Pairs Trading Strategy

Statistical arbitrage strategy for cointegrated asset pairs using Kalman-filter-based dynamic hedge ratios.

- Pairs: BTC/ETH, WTI/Brent, Gold/Silver
- Dynamic z-score entry/exit signals
- Adaptive hedge ratio estimation via Kalman filtering

---

## Swaption Demand Forecasting

Random Forest and SVM models forecasting swaption subscription demand from U.S. insurer data. Validated by senior quants at Credit Agricole CIB.

- Python/SQL pipeline for feature engineering on insurer datasets
- Ensemble and kernel-based classification models
- Model outputs used for flow-anticipation analysis
